scope: Public source/build/native summary. Private test receipts and real profile records are deliberately not distributed.

source_checks.scope: Controlled desktop/headless/GPU checks of reviewed UI changes; separate native evidence is summarized in NATIVE_QA.json.

native_summary: Current-build ordinary play, earned pause/Resume, once-only natural banking, Back, offline/cold banked retention, restored emulator-only settings and final safe stop were observed. Nine store roles were reviewed.
limits: Physical devices and physical tablets were not tested; phone and logical-tablet layouts used one Android emulator.
Audible output was not tested; the emulator audio output was disabled.
Interactive Web, Web audio/WebGL, production services, signing/consent and human gameplay balance were not verified.
Daily-specific watch victory/once-day bonus and current-build unearned SDK dismissal were not verified. Historical gift/quest/upgrade and unearned-ad observations are separately qualified.
Godot 4.5.1 Compatibility exports used minimum API24/target API35; this does not establish current Google Play eligibility.
owner_work: Real service IDs and PGS configuration
Production signing, privacy/contact/consent and store declarations
Google Play publication and human playtesting
deployment: Build/test/artifact CI is configured. No Pages deployment job exists and no live site is claimed. No remote publication is performed by this preparation.
